subject: Evergreen Plus: SOC 2 Type II, temporary bridge, and renewal cutoff for expansion
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@evergreenplus.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@evergreenplus.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter for expansion procurement

Hi Ben,

We are finalizing the procurement packet for our Evergreen Plus expansion and our legal/procurement team asked for the latest SOC 2 Type II and a temporary bridge or interim attestation that would cover the period up to your next Type II report. Our PO deadline is 2026-08-02 and procurement needs confirmation of coverage (audit period and any gaps) before sign-off.

Specifically:
- Can you provide your latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short bridge letter that confirms interim coverage between the report date and the next audit window?
- We need to confirm what audit period the Type II covers (start/end dates) and whether the bridge will cover the renewal effective date (2026-09-01).
- Procurement also asked for a one-page checklist mapping required artifacts to responsible Redwood contacts (evidence owner, expected delivery).

Appreciate a quick timeline — even a draft bridge is fine for procurement review.

Thanks,
Sara Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
Evergreen Plus
[sara.li@evergreenplus.com]

--
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@evergreenplus.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@evergreenplus.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter for expansion procurement

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and congrats on the expansion. Looping in Laura (security/compliance) and Marissa (sales ops) to own evidence and procurement touchpoints.

Short answers up front: we can provide the 2025 Type II report and a draft bridge letter that covers the gap through 2026-09-30. The Type II we have on file covers the period 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30 (we'll confirm in the PDF).

I've attached:
- SOC2_TypeII_2025-07-01.pdf (redacted vendor copy)
- bridge_letter_draft.pdf (draft, editable)
- renewal_procurement_checklist.xlsx (mapping of artifacts + owners + ETA)

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement reviews the draft bridge and tells us if legal needs alternate wording (we can iterate).
2) We submit any additional evidence items from the checklist (Laura will own evidence delivery).
3) DocuSign for bridge confirmation once language is agreed — we can send the envelope same day.

If procurement needs earlier coverage than 2026-09-30 we can discuss a scoped attestation for specific controls; let us know.

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter for expansion procurement

Hi Carlos — thanks for the question. I reviewed the draft bridge and it is a high-level interim attestation; it does not call out exceptions to controls. Language we included: "Based on our review, controls relevant to the applicable trust services criteria remained materially unchanged during the interim period."

If your team needs explicit confirmation on encryption-at-rest, key management, or retention policy changes, we can add a short addendum that lists those control families and a brief statement of status. That addendum is routine and we can provide it within 48 hours.

Ben/Marissa — if procurement confirms the addendum is required, Laura will author and deliver the addendum and any supporting evidence artifacts from the checklist.

Laura Bennett
